authority: Latest user: We can check for orthogonality to detect gradient interference among other methods. Existing user requests Luna implementation and Haiku review; keep going after fixed blockers.
purpose: Measure shared actor/critic gradient alignment before any algorithm or architectural ablation.
baseline: Accepted D2 phase132 checkpoint bf858ed9975e6f994acbca011895b140be6943cf1852c88b54549a9c8db0c1a8; same-seed evalmean1518.75, Q1bottom16mean565.8125,Q4top16mean2786.25.

primary_objectives.parameters: Only shared trainable trunk parameters, excluding actor_head and critic_head; named layer summaries additionally.

measurements: actor and weighted critic L2 norms and critic/actor norm ratio
per-layer alignment, including both transformer blocks
actual total global preclip gradient norm and clipping coefficient
zero-norm validity/reason without inventing defined cosine
interpretation: Negative cosine means opposing first-order raw gradient components. Near zero means orthogonality, positive alignment. Neither alone proves harmful interference or value failure; Adam preconditioning and global clipping affect actual updates.
sampling: First minibatch of first epoch per PPO update, using existing shuffled minibatch; no extra random draws or changed shuffle order. No additional environment steps/optimizer steps. This samples minibatch gradients, not full-rollout alignment.
trajectory_preservation: Optional flag false by default; measurement only via autograd.grad on same graph, retain_graph as necessary, no .grad/parameter/Adam/RNG/mode/batch mutation. Original combined loss.backward(), global clip and optimizer.step() remain unchanged. Require enabled/disabled CPU and MPS parity fixtures before any real campaign.
scope: Clone frozen runtime inside owned preparation directory; never edit shared original PPO/model/native/checkpoints. Synthetic fixture gradients/optimizer steps allowed for parity tests only; no real environment/training/evaluation campaign.
next_experiment: After parity/overhead measurements and Haiku frozen review, register one bounded next D2 continuation from accepted132 with diagnostics; determine update count from measured overhead, <=1800s and6GiB. No launch under this preparation task.
